name: io.github.MeorinGroup/public-records-ma
title: Meorin public records MA
description: Massachusetts property data from public records: parcel, FEMA flood, sewer, census. Paid via x402.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Free. The Massachusetts public-record property answers this server sells (parcel, assessor facts, FEMA flood zone, sewer or septic, census tract, a combined profile, the house dossier), each with its price in USD (USDC on Base via x402), its description and its public sources.

tools.name: parcel
tools.description: Massachusetts street address to tax parcel, $0.01 per call (USDC on Base via x402). Returns the Meorin parcel id, the MassGIS LOC_ID and map-parcel id, the town, ZIP, the address as the state records it and a point inside the lot. Sources: MassGIS statewide L3 tax parcels and the state NG911 address points (public records), each cited with the URL read and when. Input: address or loc_id. No owner names. No charge when no parcel matches.

address.description: A Massachusetts street address with its town, e.g. "455 Concord Ave, Belmont, MA"

loc_id.description: A MassGIS LOC_ID (the parcel tool returns it)

tools.name: parcel_facts
tools.description: Massachusetts assessor facts for a property, $0.02 per call (USDC on Base via x402): use code, zoning district, lot size, year built, living and building area, units, style, stories, rooms, assessed value (total, land, building) with its fiscal year, and the last sale over $1,000 (date and price). Source: MassGIS statewide L3 tax parcels (each town's assessor data), public records, cited. Input: address or MassGIS LOC_ID. No owner names.

address.description: A Massachusetts street address with its town, e.g. "455 Concord Ave, Belmont, MA"

loc_id.description: A MassGIS LOC_ID (the parcel tool returns it)

tools.name: flood_zone
tools.description: FEMA flood zone for a Massachusetts property, $0.02 per call (USDC on Base via x402): the zone at the parcel (AE, A, VE, X...), whether it is a Special Flood Hazard Area (flood insurance required with a federally backed mortgage), the static base flood elevation where mapped, and every zone touching the lot. Source: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer (NFHL), the state copy then FEMA's own, cited. Input: address or MassGIS LOC_ID.

address.description: A Massachusetts street address with its town, e.g. "455 Concord Ave, Belmont, MA"

loc_id.description: A MassGIS LOC_ID (the parcel tool returns it)

tools.name: sewer
tools.description: Sewer or septic for a Massachusetts property, $0.01 per call (USDC on Base via x402): whether the parcel lies inside a mapped municipal sewer service area, with the sewer system and treatment plant, or outside every one and so most likely on a septic system (a Title 5 inspection applies at sale). Source: MassDEP sewer service areas, public record, cited. Whether the building is connected is not recorded. Input: address or MassGIS LOC_ID.

address.description: A Massachusetts street address with its town, e.g. "455 Concord Ave, Belmont, MA"

loc_id.description: A MassGIS LOC_ID (the parcel tool returns it)

tools.name: census_tract
tools.description: US Census geography for a Massachusetts property, $0.01 per call (USDC on Base via x402): census tract and block group GEOIDs, county name and FIPS, and the town (county subdivision) GEOID, the keys for joining ACS, HUD, FEMA National Risk Index and other tract-level data. Source: US Census Bureau geocoder (current vintage), cited. Input: address or MassGIS LOC_ID.

address.description: A Massachusetts street address with its town, e.g. "455 Concord Ave, Belmont, MA"

loc_id.description: A MassGIS LOC_ID (the parcel tool returns it)

tools.name: property_profile
tools.description: Massachusetts property profile in one call, $0.05 (USDC on Base via x402): the tax parcel, assessor facts (use, zoning, lot, year built, area, assessed value, last sale), FEMA flood zone, sewer or likely septic, and census tract. Sources: MassGIS L3 parcels and NG911 address points, FEMA NFHL, MassDEP sewer service areas and the US Census geocoder; public records, each cited with the URL read and when. Input: address or MassGIS LOC_ID. No owner names, no MLS data.

address.description: A Massachusetts street address with its town, e.g. "455 Concord Ave, Belmont, MA"

loc_id.description: A MassGIS LOC_ID (the parcel tool returns it)

tools.name: dossier
tools.description: Massachusetts house dossier as cited JSON facts, $1.00 per call (USDC on Base via x402): parcel, building, assessments and tax by year, zoning and what the by-law allows, flood and environment, schools, permits on record, the county price trend and the ten-year big replacements; each fact with its source and citation. Public records only: no MLS, licensed or title data, no owner names. Over MCP, houses already built; HTTP GET /v1/dossier also orders new ones.
